newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Ingosstrakh starts export credit cover.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Ingosstrakh starts export credit cover.

text.p: Russia's second biggest insurer SAO Ingosstrakh has started insuring banks' credits to exporters, a senior company official said on Friday.

Viktor Klimov, head of the credit insurance department, told a news conference the company would insure banks' credits to exporters, while plans to insure loans to other companies would have to wait for further improvements in the economy.
"Insurance on other kinds of credits is not a matter of today," Klimov said. "We shall move into it as stabilisation strengthens."

Commercial credits are very risky in Russia, which is crippled by non-payment crisis and falling industrial output. Banks prefer to hold their assets in safe government securities rather than grant credits to companies.
